verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਛੀ ਫਲ ਹੇਤ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਰਖ ਰੋਪੈ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਰਹੈ ਬਿਰਖੈ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kaachhee fal het bibidh birakh ropai nihafal rahai birakhai na kaahoo kaaj hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a gardener plants saplings of many trees for obtaining fruits, but one which does not bear any fruit becomes useless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਤਿ ਨਮਿਤਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਵਾਹ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਛਾਜ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sa(n)tat namit nirap anik bivaeh karai sa(n)tat bihoon banitaa na gireh chhaaj hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a king marries many women for obtaining a heir of his kingdom, but the queen who does not bear him a child is not liked by anyone in the family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਦਾਨ ਜਾਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਂਧਾ ਚਟਸਾਰ ਜੋਰੈ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਖਲ ਨਾਮ ਉਪਰਾਜ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bidhiaa dhaan jaan jaise paa(n)dhaa chaTasaar jorai bidhiaa heen dheen khal naam uparaaj hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a teacher opens a school but the child who remains illiterate is called lazy and foolish.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਖਾ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਸੁਗਿਆਨ ਨਿਮਿਤ ਬਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਜਨਮ ਕਉ ਲਾਜਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੧੫॥
verses.translit_en: satigur sikh saakhaa sa(n)grahai sugiaan nimit bin gur giaan dhirag janam kau laaj hai ||415||

en.bdb: Similarly, True Guru holds a congregation of his disciples in order to impart them with supreme form of knowledge (Naam). But he who remains bereft of Guru's teachings, is worthy of condemnation and is a blotch on the human birth.  (415)
